translation.text: From now on there will be no one who corrupts, for that Son of Man has appeared and sat on the throne of his glory. All evil will pass away from before his face and go, and be made firm in that Son of Man, and be made firm before the Lord of Spirits. This is Enoch’s third parable.[a]

footnotes.text: The initial negative and concluding third parable are retained. Actual primary297–298 supports appearing and1288 strength/establishing, but does not settle the daggered final going/strengthening construction or its subject. The evil subject is not silently replaced by judgment. Whole wording held.
